content.short: Benqi is a leading DeFi protocol on Avalanche offering decentralized lending, borrowing, and liquid staking options.
content.description: Benqi is a comprehensive decentralized finance protocol built on the Avalanche network, featuring a non-custodial liquidity market and liquid staking solutions. Through its Benqi Liquidity Market (BLM), users can lend their assets to earn interest or borrow against supported collateral in a transparent and trustless manner. The protocol also offers liquid staking via sAVAX, which allows AVAX holders to earn staking rewards while maintaining liquidity for use in other DeFi applications. By leveraging the speed and scalability of Avalanche, Benqi provides a highly efficient environment for capital management. The protocol also includes infrastructure like Benqi Ignite to bootstrap validators.
